description: mailbox.rs line 718: the destroy loop uses 'None => continue' for non-string elements, silently ignoring them instead of returning invalidArguments. Email/set (line 1034) and EmailSubmission/set (line 470) were fixed in round-1 to return invalidArguments for non-string destroy elements (RFC 8620 §3.6.2). Mailbox/set was not fixed in round-1. This is a pre-existing gap not introduced by round-1 fixes, but it was not covered by the round-1 fix sweep.
title: Mailbox/set destroy: silently skips non-string elements
